title: Read-only Claude Bash refusal re-implements the checker's control flow; a future checker change can make it name the wrong rule
outcome: The read-only Bash checker returns a structured denial reason from the same pass that decides. claude_bash_command_is_read_only becomes a thin wrapper over it, and the refusal text in src/claude_read_only_refusal.rs reads that reason instead of re-deriving it.
acceptance: Read-only Claude Bash refusal re-implements the checker's control flow; a future checker change can make it name the wrong rule is done
